title: Controlled Proxy Comparison: Current YOLO (YOLOv8n) vs YOLOP for PSVR Front-End

H-PROXY1-A.statement: Current YOLOv8n and YOLOP detection head have measurable differences in target-domain key traffic target recall, track continuity, and cost.
H-PROXY1-A.testable: PARTIALLY — detection inference and distributional comparison possible; accuracy metrics (recall, precision, mAP) REQUIRE human annotations

H-PROXY1-B.statement: Adding YOLOP lane/drivable-derived road-relative features to YOLOP detection + ByteTrack improves cut-in candidate identification beyond motion-only features.
H-PROXY1-B.testable: PARTIALLY — road-relative features can be computed; event-level evaluation REQUIRES event labels on DrivingDojo (missing)

H-PROXY1-C.statement: YOLOP-320's cost advantage can be retained without significant loss of key vehicle trajectory and event candidate recall.
H-PROXY1-C.testable: PARTIALLY — cost profiling and detection distributional comparison executable; recall metrics REQUIRE human annotations

target_domain_video.sampling_plan: 12 windows × 20s × 5fps = 1200 frames (frozen from YOLOP sanity audit)
target_domain_video.annotations_status: MISSING — requires 400 detection frames + 600 tracking frames + 100 lane sanity frames human annotation

drivingdojo_event_set.event_labels_status: MISSING — no binary cut-in/event labels; no time-aligned event spans; STRIVE-D annotations (583 videos, 41 queries) were never publicly released
drivingdojo_event_set.alternative: Session-level tags provide weak proxy signal but cannot substitute for structured event labels

BLOCKER_1_HUMAN_ANNOTATIONS.description: Stage A (detection comparison) requires human-annotated bounding boxes on 400 frames for car/truck/bus/motorcycle/bicycle/person + attributes (near_ego_path, adjacent_lane, small_or_distant, partially_occluded). Without these, detection recall/precision/F1 cannot be computed.
BLOCKER_1_HUMAN_ANNOTATIONS.impact: All accuracy-based detection metrics blocked; can only do distributional comparison and runtime correctness
BLOCKER_1_HUMAN_ANNOTATIONS.mitigation: Can compute detection count distributions, confidence distributions, and box statistics without labels

BLOCKER_2_TRACKING_ANNOTATIONS.description: Stage B (tracking comparison) requires human-annotated track IDs on 6 full 20-second windows (~600 frames) with ego-path vehicles, adjacent-lane vehicles, and potential lateral movers.
BLOCKER_2_TRACKING_ANNOTATIONS.impact: Track recall, track continuity, and event-relevant track recall cannot be computed
BLOCKER_2_TRACKING_ANNOTATIONS.mitigation: Can compute track-level statistics (count, length, ID switches from track fragments) without labels

BLOCKER_3_DRIVINGDOJO_EVENT_LABELS.description: Stage D (event proxy) requires 200 cut-in positives + 200 hard negatives + 200 normal negatives with time-aligned binary labels. DrivingDojo-mini has only free-text description tags. STRIVE-D annotations (which contain the query-conditioned relevance labels for 583 DrivingDojo videos) were never publicly released per the asset audit.
BLOCKER_3_DRIVINGDOJO_EVENT_LABELS.impact: LightGBM event proxy training blocked; event AUPRC/recall metrics blocked; Unique Event Recall@20 blocked
BLOCKER_3_DRIVINGDOJO_EVENT_LABELS.mitigation: Can use DrivingDojo session tags as weak labels for distributional feature analysis; can run rule-baseline on target-domain video using road-relative geometry without event labels

BLOCKER_4_NO_LIGHTGBM_IMPLEMENTATION.description: No LightGBM code exists in the repository. Would need implementation from scratch.
BLOCKER_4_NO_LIGHTGBM_IMPLEMENTATION.impact: Even if labels existed, event proxy model would need to be built
BLOCKER_4_NO_LIGHTGBM_IMPLEMENTATION.mitigation: Implementation is straightforward once labels exist

what_is_executable.1_detection_inference: Run B0 (YOLOv8n), B1/B3 (YOLOP detection) on all 1200 frozen sample frames. Compare detection count distributions, confidence distributions, box geometry, and class distributions.
what_is_executable.2_tracking_inference: Implement ByteTrack wrapper; run on B0, B1, B3 detections. Compute track stats (count, length, fragmentation, ID switches) without label-dependent metrics.
what_is_executable.3_road_geometry: Extract lane-relative position, lane-relative velocity, distance-to-boundary, boundary-crossing, drivable-area overlap, lane confidence for B2/B3.
what_is_executable.4_cost_profiling: Full physical cost profile for all 4 configurations with warmup + measured frames on NVIDIA A800.
what_is_executable.5_drivingdojo_audit: Extract DrivingDojo-mini, audit contents, build manifest, run detection on all 2816 frames.
what_is_executable.6_distributional_comparison: Compare detection distributions (count per frame, area, confidence, position) between B0 and YOLOP variants.
what_is_executable.7_visual_audit: Generate overlay visualizations for visual quality assessment.

final_status_options.H-PROXY1_SELECT_CURRENT_YOLO: REQUIRES human annotations showing B0 detection recall >= B1+5pp AND B2 road-geometry doesn't improve event recall
final_status_options.H-PROXY1_SELECT_YOLOP_640: REQUIRES human annotations showing B2 achieves event-relevant track recall + B2 unique event recall improvement + throughput >= 5fps
final_status_options.H-PROXY1_SELECT_YOLOP_320: REQUIRES human annotations showing B3 retains >=95% of B2's metrics with >=25% lower cost
final_status_options.H-PROXY1_REVISE_HYBRID: REQUIRES human annotations showing B0 detection beats B1 BUT B2 road-geometry beats B1
final_status_options.H-PROXY1_INCONCLUSIVE: If confidence intervals overlap or DrivingDojo labels cannot support event definition
final_status_options.H-PROXY1_BLOCKED_WAITING_FOR_ANNOTATIONS: CURRENT STATUS — human annotations and event labels are prerequisites for the primary metrics

decision.reason: Human-perception annotations (400 detection + 600 tracking + 100 lane frames) and DrivingDojo structured event labels are prerequisites for Stages A-D accuracy/tracking/event metrics. Executable work is limited to inference, distributional comparison, cost profiling, and visual audit.
decision.executable_next_step: Run full inference pipeline (B0 detection + B1/B2/B3 YOLOP + ByteTrack tracking) on the frozen 1200-frame sample plan. Produce cost profiles, distributional comparisons, road-geometry features, and visual audit assets. These results enable rapid completion when annotations become available.
unblock_conditions: Human annotation of 400 detection frames + 600 tracking frames from long_video_dataset3.mp4
Structured event labels for DrivingDojo sessions (or alternative labeled event dataset)
Implementation of LightGBM event proxy pipeline
